behavior: When a popup closes, focus goes to the first of these that can take it. The order is `finalFocus`, the trigger, the element that had focus before the popup opened, the first tabbable element of the parent popup, and the newest element that had focus before an earlier open. When no click on the trigger opened the popup, the element that had focus before the popup opened comes before the trigger. An element that is not in the document, or that has the `hidden` attribute or an ancestor with it, cannot take focus. After a press on the backdrop in a browser without `preventScroll`, an explicit `finalFocus` still gets focus.
